Title: Ultimate Ramen Tasting Tour - SHIBUYA
Description:
Join Tokyo's only Ramen Tasting Tour (with mini bowls, each 1/4 the size of full bowls)!

You'll taste 6 wildly different types of delicious ramen at 3 award-winning ramen shops. You'll even get to choose the 6 ramen from 11-12 types, via fun, customizable menus. Each ramen boasts unique flavors - whether a light, salt-based chicken ramen or a creamy pork bone ramen.

Furthermore, you'll learn all about ramen during the 3 hours - its history and future, how it's prepared, and how to eat it like a true local.

* The tour starts in Shibuya *OR* Shinjuku *OR* Ueno and ends in Ebisu, Akasaka-Mitsuke, or Ueno.
* Please double check your booked route: each meeting point is different (SHIBUYA, SHINJUKU, UENO)
* All ramen broths contain chicken, pork, and fish. For vegans or vegetarians, please book our Vegan / Vegetarian Ramen Tasting Tour.
* The tour involves a good amount of walking (approximately 3 kilometers, or 1.86 miles) and isn't recommended for people with a low level of fitness.

Title: Exclusive Ramen Kitchen Experience
Description:
You'll get to experience exactly what it's like to be a ramen chef, right in an actual ramen shop kitchen!

This experience takes place in one of Tokyo's best ramen shops which has won several awards. The ramen shop has kindly offered us exclusive access - something normally not available!

Title: Vegan / Vegatarian Ramen Tour
Description:
Join Tokyo's best Vegan/Vegatarian Ramen Tasting Tour! 

You'll get to enjoy 4 mini bowls of carefully crafted ramen - all vegan, with non-vegan broth options available for each. Gluten-free noodles are also available, making this tour both flexible and inclusive - perfect for ramen lovers of all kinds. 

The tour takes you to two standout ramen shops in Shibuya and Shinjuku (we'll take the train!): one specializing in authentic Hokkaido-style ramen, the other in classic Tokyo tsukemen (dipping ramen). Along the way, you'll learn about ramen's regional roots and why Tokyo and Hokkaido have played such important roles in shaping the dish's history.

Title: Tokyo Street Food Tour - 7 Japanese Foods
Description:
Embark on a delicious Street Food Tour in Togoshi Ginza, a hidden culinary gem of Tokyo. Togoshi Ginza is in the record books - it's Tokyo's longest shopping street, with over 400 shops.

You'll get to enjoy a wide range of tasty Japanese food - from award-winning Japanese fried chicken (karaage) to extra rich Japanese pudding.

Throughout the tour we'll also provide insightful commentary about the history and evolution behind each of the dishes you eat. In short, indulge your taste buds in a delightful mix of savory and sweet treats, all while immersing yourself in the local and welcoming atmosphere of Togoshi Ginza.

Title: Breakfast Ramen Tour in Shinjuku
Description:
Want to have ramen for breakfast? Join Tokyo’s only Breakfast Ramen Tour and start your day with 3 delicious mini bowls of ramen!
Also, see what one of Tokyo's most dynamic neighborhoods (Kabukicho, Shinjuku) is like during the early morning and learn all about ramen from our expert ramen guide.

You'll first meet your guide for coffee or tea, discussing ramen origins and even taking part in a ramen quiz! After this, you'll visit the first ramen shop, which specializes in classic Tokyo shoyu (soy sauce) ramen. You'll get to enjoy 2 mini bowls there.

You'll then head over to the second ramen shop, where the mini ramen bowl is tonkotsu (pork bone) based and infused with delicious garlic oil.

Try 3 mini bowls of ramen + gyoza pork dumplings

Learn about shoyu ramen and tonkotsu ramen history and prep

Get to know Tokyo's most vibrant area (Kabukicho, Shinjuku) with your guide

Title: Kyoto Ramen Tour
Description:
Discover Kyoto's impressive ramen scene on our Insider Kyoto Ramen Tour! Explore both classic and modern ramen and get a better understanding about the wonderful world of ramen with our expert guide.

You'll visit two ramen shops for two wildly different bowls of ramen. One bowl will represent classic Kyoto ramen and the other, more modern ramen. Each bowl is smaller than normal (about 1/2 the size of a full bowl). At the beginning of the tour, you'll sit down with the guide to enjoy a cup of coffee or tea. Alongside this, you'll discuss Kyoto ramen origins and the ramen route on the tour - the shops you'll be visiting!

Title: Tokyo Vegan Food Tour
Description:
Experience a dynamic Vegan Food Tour through the vibrant streets of Tokyo’s Shibuya and Ebisu neighborhoods, and discover the rich world of Japanese plant-based cuisine!

Guided by our expert food enthusiasts, you’ll sample an array of distinctive Japanese vegan delights, such as:
- Mini bowls of Hokkaido-style ramen (with choices including spicy miso, miso, shoyu, and shio)
- Flavorful Vegan Gyoza Dumplings
- Crunchy Vegan Karaage (a twist on Japanese fried chicken)
- Unique Fruit Sandwiches with fresh seasonal fruits
- Decadent Butter and Anko (sweet bean paste) Sandwiches

As you explore, gain insights into the cultural stories behind each dish, uncover the secrets of local ingredients, cooking techniques, and the surge of vegan dining across Japan. Additionally, get practical tips on navigating Tokyo’s vegan scene—including a quick stop at a convenience store!

Join this Tokyo Vegan Food Tour and celebrate Japan’s culinary diversity—100% plant-based, 100% unforgettable!

Description:
This tour offers an immersive experience, featuring four mini bowls of ramen across two renowned ramen shops, each embodying the essence of Tokyo's nocturnal culinary scene.

Tour Highlights:

  • Four Mini Bowls: Savor a curated selection of mini ramen bowls, allowing you to experience a variety of flavors without overindulging.
  • Two Iconic Ramen Shops: Visit two distinguished establishments celebrated for their exceptional ramen and significant contributions to Tokyo's food culture.
  • Late-Night Exploration: Discover the integral role ramen plays in Tokyo's nightlife, akin to enjoying a late-night kebab in Berlin or a slice of pizza in New York.

This tour not only satisfies your palate but also enriches your understanding of why ramen is a cornerstone of Tokyo's after-hours dining, a concept central to the 5 AM Ramen brand. Join us to experience Tokyo's late-night ramen offerings firsthand.

Title: Ebisu Hidden Cocktail Bar Tour
Description:
Step into the world of Japanese mixology on this intimate cocktail tour through four tucked-away bars in Tokyo’s upscale Ebisu neighborhood. Led by a local expert, you’ll sip your way through a variety of Japanese flavors like a local - from house-infused spirits and craft tea cocktails to sake and small-batch whiskey - all while learning about the culture, craft, and history behind them.

Expect exclusive access to secret speakeasies and artisan bars where seasoned bartenders might even shake up something just for you. Each stop includes a carefully selected cocktail, a small plate, and insights into the philosophies that define Japan’s cocktail scene. Cover charges are all taken care of by us as well!

This tour is:

  • Low-walking and transit-free, staying entirely within walkable Ebisu
  • Vegan-friendly with flexible options at each stop
  • Welcoming to guests 14+, with non-alcoholic options available at some venues (please note: alcoholic drinks only served to those 20+ per Japanese law)
  • Capped at 4 guests max to keep the experience personal and immersive

Title: Shinjuku Izakaya Food & Drink Tour
Description:
Step into the lively heart of Tokyo after dark and explore Shinjuku’s izakaya culture like a local. Over the course of an evening, we’ll take you beyond the typical tourist path - from a nostalgic wooden tavern that feels like stepping back in time, to a bustling spot serving seasonal comfort dishes, and finally to a modern skewer-focused bar tucked inside the iconic Omoide Yokocho alleyway.

Guided by a local food expert, you’ll enjoy three unique venues, each offering its own take on Japanese hospitality, flavors, and atmosphere. Between bites and sips, you’ll get a deeper look into how izakayas work, what makes them so integral to Tokyo’s social life, and the unwritten rules locals follow.

What’s Included:

• Three izakaya visits in Shinjuku, each with its own specialty

• A total of three drinks (alcoholic or non-alcoholic) included

• Generous small plates and shared dishes at each stop - enough for dinner

Example Dishes You Might Try:

• Fresh sashimi, grilled shiitake mushrooms, shrimp, and satsuma-age fish cakes in a historic wooden izakaya

• Tamagoyaki (Japanese omelet), seasonal vegetable tempura, oden, and even wagyu beef at a neighborhood favorite

• Charcoal-grilled yakitori and pork skewers, along with side dishes, in a lively modern izakaya inside Omoide Yokocho

Whether it’s your first night in Tokyo or your fifth visit to Japan, this is a warm, flavorful introduction to the world of izakayas - and a chance to eat and drink like a true local.

Title: Osaka Street Food Tour
Description:
Step off Osaka’s busy tourist trail and explore a true local gem - Japan’s longest shopping street.

While most visitors stick to the crowds of Namba and Shinsaibashi, this walking food tour takes you into the heart of Tenjinbashisuji, a nearly 2-kilometer-long arcade filled with locals, not tourists. It may be Japan’s longest shopping street, but it’s also home to some of Osaka’s most underrated street food spots - hidden in plain sight.

As we stroll through this lively neighborhood near Umeda, you’ll sample a variety of Osaka’s iconic street foods, including:

• Crispy kushikatsu (deep-fried skewers)

• Classic takoyaki (octopus balls)

• Savory okonomiyaki (Japanese-style pancake)

• Fresh-fried croquettes

• Warm, sweet taiyaki

• Silky tofu pudding

Along the way, your guide will share stories about Osaka’s unique food culture, the history of this vibrant neighborhood, and what makes this city Japan’s true culinary capital.

Whether it’s your first time in Osaka or your fifth, this is a food tour designed to take you deeper - and leave you full.
